curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What begins as an upbeat holiday escape quickly unravels as bizarre disruptions take over the secluded house.
curatedMovie.description: A group of students gathers at an isolated manor house to ring in the New Year. Shortly after arriving, strange occurrences disrupt the celebration, quickly turning their getaway into an escalating nightmare.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Suspenseful yet comic, this moderate-weight holiday fright unfolds at an engaging, steady pace.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Tony T. Datis, this French horror-comedy balances lively party energy with creeping dread inside a classic isolated estate.
